integrity.scope: Exact finite-sample proof and cited finite-population functional limit; independently reproducible rational checks

scientific_limitations: Fixed-count shuffle / common continuous null; exact mixed second moment only; no joint law or independence claim.
The correlation limit requires \(a/N\to p\in(0,1)\), and uses classical finite-population bridge convergence.
Equivalent work in inaccessible older historical sources cannot be excluded.
title: Exact negative runs–Cramér–von Mises covariance and a universal correlation constant
